business_problem: LegalOn needed to preserve the development-speed gains from Codex while preventing AI spending from growing uncontrollably as model usage expanded across the organization.
solution_summary: LegalOn Technologies treated model selection and budget control as part of its engineering system rather than an after-the-fact finance task. After initially giving developers broad access to GPT-5.5 Fast mode and embedding Codex into design, implementation, and daily work, the company saw that unlimited use of top-tier models would exceed budget. Its AI-powered Development CoE created model-selection guidelines backed by testing and monitoring, then paired those rules with administrator controls and monthly usage limits for departments and individuals. Under the new operating model, GPT-6 Luna handles everyday implementation and simpler delegated tasks, GPT-6.1 Sol supports standard design, analysis, and documents, and GPT-6 Astra is reserved for complex architecture and orchestration. Budgets are also tuned to business maturity, keeping high-growth areas aggressive while requiring established units to improve efficiency without slowing overall delivery.

solution_components.name: Codex
solution_components.role: Provides the AI coding surface embedded across LegalOn’s development process and daily engineering work.

solution_components.name: GPT-6 Luna
solution_components.role: Handles lightweight implementation, automations, and simpler delegated engineering tasks.

solution_components.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
solution_components.role: Supports standard software design, analysis, and document creation that require moderate reasoning.

solution_components.name: GPT-6 Astra
solution_components.role: Handles complex analysis, architectural design, and orchestration for the hardest engineering work.

data_flow: Engineering tasks are routed through Codex and then assigned to Luna, Sol, or Astra depending on complexity and delivery stage. Usage data is monitored through administrator settings and budget caps so teams can keep shipping while leadership reallocates AI spend across mature and growth businesses.
business_outcome: LegalOn maintained development speed while cutting estimated daily AI costs, improved cost efficiency in mature business units, and created a governance model that ties model choice and future ROI measurement to customer value.
metrics: Up to approximately 20% cost-efficiency improvement in mature businesses
